heroHeadline: Saudi Pipeline Restarts, Iran Proposes Phased Hormuz Reopening as Brent Falls Below $100
heroSubtitle: Saudi Arabia restarted its East-West pipeline Sep 22 after a two-week shutdown, sending Brent crude below $100 a barrel for the first time in weeks; Iran then presented US envoys a roadmap for a 60-day regional ceasefire and phased Hormuz reopening, with Brent extending its slide to $98.44 on Sep 23
footerNote: Data sourced from official reports (FAO, World Bank, IMF, IEA, WFP), major outlets (Reuters, Bloomberg, Al Jazeera, CNBC), and institutional analyses (Lloyd's List, S&P Global, IFPRI, Atlantic Council).
